name: voxellab
author: VoxelLab contributors
description: VoxelLab: local-first research imaging viewer with browser and Electron desktop entrypoints.

scripts.build: npm run gen:sw && npm run render:config
scripts.desktop:smoke: npm run desktop:ensure-electron && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/electron-runtime-smoke.mjs tests/electron-nifti-smoke.mjs tests/electron-tiff-sequence-smoke.mjs tests/electron-microscopy-workflow-smoke.mjs
scripts.desktop:check: node scripts/check_electron_desktop.mjs && node scripts/check_electron_package.mjs && node scripts/check_release_workflow.mjs && node --test tests/electron-desktop-contract.test.mjs && npm run desktop:smoke
scripts.lint: eslint js electron scripts tests viewer.js --max-warnings 0 && node --no-warnings --experimental-strip-types node_modules/oxlint/bin/oxlint js electron scripts tests viewer.js
scripts.check: npm run check:docs && npm run check:js && npm run check:py && npm run check:data && npm run check:geometry && npm run test:node
scripts.check:fast: npm run check:docs && npm run check:js:fast && npm run check:py && npm run check:data && npm run check:validation && npm run check:geometry && npm run check:reference-parity && npm run test:python && npm run test:node
scripts.check:js: npm run check:js:fast && npm run desktop:check
scripts.check:js:fast: npm run lint:ci && npm run check:js:syntax && npm run check:js:types:boundaries && npm run check:styles
scripts.check:js:syntax: node --check viewer.js && for f in $(find js -name '*.js') electron/main/*.js electron/shared/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && node --check electron/preload/index.cjs
scripts.check:data: node scripts/run_python.mjs scripts/check_manifest.py --manifest data/manifest.json --config config.json && node scripts/run_python.mjs scripts/check_assets.py --manifest data/manifest.json --mode local-fast
scripts.test: npm run test:node && npm run test:browser
